result.summary: Detected only by stacking: deblended forced-PSF photometry gives S/N = 8.1, 8.1 in independent matched sets at 4.22 and 4.37 µm, and nothing at 0.94–3.3 µm, as expected for a Y dwarf. Free-position fits sit on the predicted track (offsets ≤ 0.75"); the measured shift (2.7" ± 1.69" per axis over 186 d) matches the 3.3" predicted, but a stationary source is rejected only weakly (χ² = 2.51, 2 dof).

limitations: SPHEREx pixels are 6.15"; positions come from a Gaussian PSF fit, not the pipeline EPSF, so absolute centroids can carry sub-pixel PSF-model bias. It largely cancels between matched-wavelength frames of the same detector, and the Gaia field-star floor measures what is left.

Per detector, at most two matched sets were measured: the one with the most visits and the one with the longest baseline. For variable stars the shortest-wavelength D1 set was added. Other matched sets exist (see observations_examined.matched_set_candidates).
DR1 spans about one year, so motion baselines are at most ~12 months and parallax is not separated from proper motion: the prediction includes both.
WISE 0855 is a ~250 K Y dwarf: undetectable by SPHEREx below ~3.5 µm and brightest at 4.5–5 µm (D6), where single 112-s exposures are shallow.

A G = 16.3 Gaia DR3 field star (5756956644387831296) lies 2.6–11" from WISE 0855's track during DR1 (0.4–1.8 SPHEREx pixels). At 0.9–2.4 µm it is the only source detected near the prediction, and it is stationary. Near 4.8 µm it is blended with WISE 0855, so WISE 0855's flux there depends on the simultaneous EPSF fit (target and star at fixed catalogue positions).

WISE 0855 is not in Gaia. Its astrometry is the SIMBAD compilation (Kirkpatrick et al. 2021; position at epoch J2000.0, no position error listed). Propagated to the AllWISE epoch it agrees with the source's AllWISE designation to ~1".
Only per-set stacks of ≤5 frames at a single matched wavelength are combined. A deeper all-channel D6 stack was not attempted because it would mix wavelengths.
method: Positions/fluxes measured on each frame's native pixel grid with its own WCS (no resampling). Wavelength at the target from each cutout's own WCS-WAVE. Frames compared only within a same-detector set whose wavelengths at the target agree within half a channel bandwidth. Astrometry: weighted Gaussian PSF fit; WCS zero point and empirical precision from isolated Gaia DR3 stars propagated (proper motion + parallax) to each DATE-AVG. Photometry: aperture minus annulus, common valid-pixel mask across epochs, differential against non-variable Gaia reference stars; empirical errors from blank-sky control apertures and reference-star scatter.

stationary_source_near_prediction.interpretation: A stationary ordinary star (Gaia G=16.3). WISE 0855 cannot be detected at these wavelengths, and its predicted track moves ~8"/yr past this star.

catalogue_vs_allwise_designation.note: designation coordinates are truncated and the AllWISE mean epoch is approximate; ~1" agreement is expected
